title: 2026 UK ETS maritime annual-report verification QA controls

sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for maritime: how to comply

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Participating in the UK ETS

facts.source_fact: The first maritime UK ETS scheme year runs from 1 July to 31 December 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Use the half-year 2026 monitoring period rather than a full calendar year.

facts.source_fact: From 2027, the maritime scheme year runs from 1 January to 31 December.
Data collected under the approved monitoring plan are used to prepare the annual emissions report.
facts.expected_handling: Trace report values to monitored data and plan version.

facts.source_fact: The verified annual emissions report must be submitted by 31 March in the year following the scheme year.
Verified annual emissions reports can be submitted to the Environment Agency between 1 January and 31 March following the scheme year.
facts.expected_handling: Keep preparation availability distinct from the formal submission window.

facts.source_fact: If the annual emissions report is late, the task becomes overdue, the Environment Agency may determine emissions and charge for this, and a civil penalty may apply.
facts.expected_handling: Flag late reporting without fabricating the regulator-determined value.

facts.source_fact: An annual emissions report cannot be amended after submission; discovered errors must be raised with the Environment Agency.
facts.expected_handling: Treat submitted reports as locked and route corrections through regulator process.

facts.source_fact: Annual emissions reports must be verified by an independent verifier accredited by UKAS.
facts.expected_handling: Require verifier accreditation and independence evidence.

facts.source_fact: The verifier's verification report must be submitted with the annual emissions report.
facts.expected_handling: Do not mark annual reporting complete without both reports.

facts.source_fact: Operators are advised to appoint and engage the verifier early so data can be reviewed and misstatements corrected before the deadline.
facts.expected_handling: Record verification as an ongoing control, not a last-minute formality.

guard_patterns.handling: Apply 2026 half-year versus later calendar-year periods.
Trace report data to approved monitoring plan.
Separate report availability from submission window.
Require annual report plus verification report.
Do not invent emissions where EA determination is pending.
Retain official guidance provenance and date.
Flag period, deadline, verifier or report inconsistencies.
